title: Update TermsPage hidden admin link to word 'Sia'

requirements.text: In frontend/src/pages/TermsPage.tsx, update the hidden admin entry point so that the word 'Sia' appears as the very last word of the last condition/paragraph on the page. Style it to blend naturally into the surrounding body text (same font size, same color, no underline by default) so it is not visually distinct. Clicking 'Sia' must navigate to /admin. All other Terms & Conditions content must remain completely unchanged.

quotes: make it a small text word Sia at the last conditions last word and by clicking it it shows the admin panel

acceptanceCriteria: The word 'Sia' is rendered as the last word of the last condition on the Terms & Conditions page.
The word 'Sia' is styled to visually blend into the surrounding paragraph text — matching font size, color, and weight — with no underline or other distinguishing decoration in its default state.
Clicking 'Sia' navigates the user directly to /admin without any password prompt or intermediate screen.
No other text content on the Terms & Conditions page is added, removed, or altered.
The entry point does not appear in the site header, footer, or any navigation menu.
The hidden link works correctly in both light mode and dark mode.

constraints: Do not add any visible label such as 'Admin' near the hidden link.
Do not alter any other content or layout on TermsPage.
Do not add any authentication or password prompt on the /admin route.
nonGoals: Changing the admin panel UI or functionality.
Adding any new Terms & Conditions content.
